text.en:
A new paragraph after the third paragraph of Section 12 of Republic Act Numbered 1789, as
amended, is hereby concluded to read as follows:
In case the private end-user is a Filipino citizen or entity wholly owned by Filipino citizens engaged in
shipbuilding and duly registered with the Board of Investments, the balance payable in installments for capital
goods and complementary services disposed of on credit basis shall be subject to an interest rate of three (3%)
per cent per annum: Provided, That the mortgage to the Commission of the capital goods disposed of to said
persons or entities engaged in shipbuilding shall constitute sufficient collateral for the same.

All laws, decrees, rules and regulations inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed or amended
accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 15th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
